from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u033/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    templates = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] == color and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); stack.append((ny,nx))
            minr = min(y for y,x in cells); minc = min(x for y,x in cells)
            shape = frozenset((y-minr, x-minc) for y,x in cells)
            objects.append((color, cells, shape))
            if color == 8:
                templates.add(shape)
    for color, cells, shape in objects:
        if color != 8 and shape in templates:
            for r, c in cells:
                out[r][c] = 8
    return out
'''
p=program_dir/'task-430db46b.py'
p.write_text(code)
